description: This file contains trigger decoder implementations for Mazda engines within the rusEfi firmware project. It defines functions to initialize various trigger shapes and sensor configurations, primarily for Mazda Miata and Protege models, handling trigger events, synchronization, and sensor configurations.

methods.name: initializeMazdaMiataNaShape
methods.description: Sets up a trigger shape for Mazda Miata with a specific event sequence useful for ignition timing detection.

methods.name: initialize_Mazda_Engine_z5_Shape
methods.description: Initializes trigger shape with specific event timings, likely for a particular Mazda engine configuration with a specific trigger pattern.

methods.name: initializeMazdaMiataNb2Crank
methods.description: Configures a trigger shape for Mazda Miata with a particular crank sensor setup, defining event positions for primary events.

methods.name: initializeMazdaMiataNb1ShapeWithOffset
methods.description: Initializes a Mazda Miata trigger shape with a configurable offset, used for secondary or alternative trigger configurations.

methods.name: initializeMazdaMiataNb1Shape
methods.description: Wrapper around the offset version, initializing a specific Miata Nb1 trigger shape with zero offset.

methods.name: initializeMazdaMiataVVtTestShape
methods.description: Initializes a trigger shape for testing Variable Valve Timing (VVT) on Mazda Miata with specific offset to adapt trigger pattern.

methods.name: configureMazdaProtegeSOHC
methods.description: Configures trigger shape for Mazda Protege with SOHC engine, using a pattern of rising and falling edges for synchronization.

methods.name: configureMazdaProtegeLx
methods.description: Configures a trigger shape for Mazda Protege LX, setting up multiple trigger events with specific timing, including secondary sensor handling.
